# Observable static snapshot v1 consumer fixtures

Accepted Styio PLAN-004 fixtures were copied verbatim from
`tests/fixtures/observable_static_snapshot/v1/` in the Styio sibling worktree.
Vityo keeps a small authored change-pair so exact added/removed opaque IDs stay
stable for change-set, controller, and surface tests. Remaining Vityo-owned
negative fixtures follow the frozen schema-v1 record shapes.
